title: Models including preoperative plasma levels of angiogenic factors, leptin and IL-8 as potential biomarkers of endometrial cancer
summary: The model reports ROC AUC 0.89 on training and held-out test data from prospective clinical sampling. This is a single-center result requiring multicenter confirmation; prospective sampling does not establish clinical benefit.
ai_technology: A machine-learning classifier combines preoperative plasma angiogenic-factor, leptin and IL-8 measurements to predict endometrial cancer.
